verdict.rationale: Fenwick runs client-facing software, such as its custom trademark extranet, so data portability is a fair question to ask. The extranet docs describe immediate, complete access to trademark data and documents, plus reporting. Viewing access and reporting are adjacent features, though: nothing documents bulk export of all client data in open formats or a path to take that data and leave.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
